facts.fact: The 2024 finance law (Loi 2023-18 of 15 December 2023) gave the digital economy sector of the Ministry of Communication, Telecommunications and Digital CFA 16.1bn, within a CFA 42.7bn ministry envelope.
The digital economy sector's budget rose 93.2% from CFA 16.1bn in 2024 to CFA 31.1bn in 2025, per committee reporting of 17 December 2024.
